build_linear_crf_model: build a linear-chain CRF model with potentials and transitions graphs for sequence labeling
create_transition_graph: create a bigram transition graph with nodes and arcs for a given number of classes
create_potential_graph: create a unary potential graph with arcs for each feature and class combination
sample_crf_model: sample sequences from a linear-chain CRF model using Viterbi decoding and graph composition
compute_crf_loss: compute the CRF loss by composing feature graphs and computing forward scores for normalization
